title: The Untouchable Moguls
description: Smashed through the $500k ceiling. Either a savant or you blindly rode a rocket and survived.

title: The Comfortable Upper Class
description: Didn't take the ultimate crown, but walking out significantly richer than the rest of the room.

title: The Break-Even Survivors
description: Played with caution. Your net worth barely budged, but your dignity remains intact.

title: Liquidated Degenerates
description: Rode every rocket into the ground. Your portfolio looks like a crime scene, but the stories were legendary.
